I've been told, in order to qualify for a refund, I needed to put the refund request in whilst I was up all night in the airport trying frantically to get home, not 2 days later. Every person I've spoken to on their customer support line has either hung up on me or said they'll ring me back but not a single person has. I can't stress enough how bad this experience was. reviews.title: An Outrageous Experience with FLYONE - Deplorable Customer Service
reviews.text: I am ordinarily not one to write negative reviews, but my recent experience with FLYONE Airlines leaves me no other choices. The hope is that by sharing this, potential customers might be separated the frustration and financial losses I faced. Let me paint a picture of a situation you'd never want to find yourself in. I was due to fly, in the hopes of seeing my ailing father who was in intense therapy in a hospital. One would hope that amidst such emotional turmoil, a simple process like catching a flight would be straightforward. How gravely mistaken I was. FLYONE's flight was delayed. These things happen, I understand. But when the unexpected strikes, isn't that when a company's service should truly shine? Instead, I one answering the call, their system proved to be so obsolete and unsympathetic, that it refused to allow me to re-register for a new flight. In my hour of need, stranded and desperate, I was forced to buy an entirely new ticket just to reach my destination. One might argue that unforeseen problems can occur. However, what is utterly indefensible is the fact that I have spent a full month attempting to get my money refunded, with my pleas falling on deaf ears. Each passing day reiterates the fact that FLYONE does not care about their customers, that they are only interested in their bottom line. Not a shred of humanity, empathy, or decency has been displayed in their communication. For a company that claims to put its customers first, their actions speak louder than their hollow words. The distress they have added to an already agonizing situation is unconscionable. It's clear to me that FLYONE's lack of basic business ethics and blatant disregard for customer welfare makes them undeserving of any consumer's trust or hard-earned money. I implore you, as a potential passenger, to think twice before entrusting your journey to FLYONE. I urge FLYONE, as a service provider, to make amends not only in my case, but to ensure no other customer has to face such an atrocious lack of support ever again. Lastly, I request the intervention of relevant authorities and consumer protection agencies to look into this matter seriously. We, as customers, should not have to beg for empathy or fairness; it should be the cornerstone of any service industry. #FLYONEFail #CustomerServiceDisaster

reviews.text: I have flown with FlyOne 3 times. The first 2 times the flight had delayed for 2 hours and I found out it already in airport. But it was nothing in comparison with my last flight... I had to fly from Armenia to Georgia. I had 2 big suitcases 23-24 kg each. When I booked tickets, there was an option to choose 25 kg baggage, so I did it. We bought some stuff and another suitcase in Armenia which was 8 kg. I decided to buy additional baggage and there was an option to buy 20kg+, but I needed only 8-10 kg. So I called on a hotline (!) of FlyOne and I was told that I can just increase my 25 kg limit to 30 kg for both suitcases and bring additional baggage 60 KG in TOTAL (I'm stressing that I WAS TOLD IT BY FLYONE'S EMPLOYEE). So I paid for additional 10 kg. Finally, I arrived at airport and I was told on the check-in desk that I can't bring 3 suitcases, because I paid only for 2. And I have to buy more luggage, and they gave me the BILL OF 110 US DOLLARS. So I paid additional 110 dollars on top of ~90 dollars that I already paid before.
